task: Investigate in the Hugging Face documentation how to utilize the 'Trainer' API for training a model on a custom dataset, and note the configurable parameters of the Trainer class.
answer: Final Response: Investigated the Hugging Face documentation on using the Trainer API for training a model on a custom dataset. Sources: https://huggingface.co/docs (Docs hub), https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/training (Fine-tuning tutorial), and https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main_classes/trainer (Trainer API reference). How to use the Trainer API on a custom dataset: (1) load and tokenize your custom dataset (e.g., with datasets.load_dataset and a tokenizer) to produce input_ids/attention_mask labels; (2) load a pretrained model via AutoModelFor...; (3) configure training hyperparameters with TrainingArguments; (4) instantiate Trainer(model=model, args=training_args, train_dataset=..., eval_dataset=..., processing_class=tokenizer, data_collator=...); (5) call trainer.train() to fine-tune and optionally trainer.push_to_hub() to upload. Key configurable Trainer/TrainingArguments parameters noted from the docs: output_dir, num_train_epochs, per_device_train_batch_size, per_device_eval_batch_size, gradient_accumulation_steps, learning_rate, weight_decay, warmup_steps, logging_steps, eval_strategy, save_strategy, save_steps, fp16, bf16, load_best_model_at_end, metric_for_best_model, report_to, push_to_hub, dataloader_num_workers, optim (plus many more TrainingArguments such as max_steps, lr_scheduler_type, max_grad_norm, seed, evaluation_strategy, logging_dir, resume_from_checkpoint, etc.).
